result.narrative: Boeing sits in the Watch band at a score of 27.8, driven almost entirely by negative news rather than payment behavior. The underlying trade payment record is clean: no open overdues, only one minor 3-day/$650k delay in the past six months, and a $9M accepted credit line, though the single historical data point means confidence in a payment trend is low. The score is instead carried by a severity-4 layoffs headline from three days ago, "Boeing leaves open possibility of more layoffs amid stalled production plans," which alone contributes nearly all of the weighted news score.

judgement.bottom_line: Maintain the $9M limit for Tamrin Exports (TCI) as recommended; the adjudicator agreed with caveats, flagging that the score rests on a thinly-sourced headline and should be read with some caution rather than taken at face value.

lifts_it: Score would need to fall 7.8 points to reach the Healthy band

worsens_it: Score rising 22.2 points to 50.0 would trigger High Risk
A payment delay reaching 33 days past due would be enough to push into the next band
Additional corroborating layoffs, production-delay, or regulatory-scrutiny headlines reinforcing the operational-strain narrative
